name: rocrate-mcp-server
description: MCP server exposing RO-Crate editing and profile-aware validation tools

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-workflow-docs-bundle.js && tsc -b && shx mkdir -p lib/dashboard/static && shx cp -r src/dashboard/static/. lib/dashboard/static/
